summary.text: Dean Brewer of Knoxville is an independent candidate for governor who qualified by petition, filing on March 10, 2026.

A May 2026 independent voter guide quoted him as saying, "It's time we remember how to be America and work together as Americans again," and reported that he has described a program to house homeless veterans and provide counseling and on-the-job trade training. No occupation or other biographical detail could be sourced.
